title: Public API PATCH: blank name 422, key without parts:write 403, look-alike not stocked alongside 200
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Two public API keys: one WITH parts:write and one WITHOUT. Requests go to PATCH /api/v1/parts/{id} on the sv10647 API host, {id} = QAPL-B1's part id at Staging Heavy Duty. Data: QAPL-B1 (stocked at both locations; note its description); QAPL-E1 (an entry with no part behind it, so its number is stocked at no location).
custom_steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/parts/{id} with the parts:write key, body {"name":" "}.
  2. PATCH /api/v1/parts/{id} with the key WITHOUT parts:write, body {"name":"QAPL-B1 no write"}.
  3. PATCH /api/v1/parts/{id} with the parts:write key, body {"part_number":"qapl.e1"} (matches QAPL-E1 only when case and punctuation are ignored).
  4. In the app: Inventory at Staging Heavy Duty and at Staging Lethbridge > search "qapl.e1"; then Part Library > search "qapl.e1" and "QAPL-E1".
  5. Open the part's Part History (row history icon) at each location.
  6. PATCH /api/v1/parts/{id} with the parts:write key, body {"part_number":"QAPL-B1"}.
custom_expected:
1. 422; QAPL-B1's description is unchanged in the app.
  2. 403; nothing changes (description unchanged at both locations).
  3. 200: no QAPL-E1 part is stocked at a location that stocks QAPL-B1, so the look-alike is not refused.
  4. Both locations show the part as "qapl.e1"; the Part Library lists "qapl.e1" and "QAPL-E1" as separate entries.
  5. At both locations the newest entry reads "Part number updated | Original number: QAPL-B1 | New number: qapl.e1 | Changed through: Public API" (no "Changed at").
  6. 200; both locations read "QAPL-B1" again.
